strings.apt.why.build_essential: tools for building the training programs
strings.apt.why.cmake: also needed to build the training programs
strings.apt.why.python3_dev: lets the training programs be built for this computer
strings.apt.why.python3_venv: keeps this tool's programs separate from the rest of the computer
strings.budget.level.not_enough: There is not enough room for this.
strings.budget.level.tight: Room is tight. You can carry on, but it may run out.
strings.budget.watch.stop: Free space is very low, so training is being stopped now to protect your recordings.
strings.fetch.error.cancelled.changed: The part downloaded so far was kept, so it can carry on later.
strings.fetch.error.cancelled.next: Start it again whenever you like.
strings.fetch.error.checksum.changed: The bad file was deleted. Nothing else was changed.
strings.fetch.error.checksum.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, the file may have changed at its source, so save a problem report.
strings.fetch.error.checksum.what: The file that arrived did not match what was agreed, so it cannot be trusted.
strings.fetch.error.consent.next: Open the list of downloads, look it over, and agree to it.
strings.fetch.error.consent.what: The download was not started because it has not been agreed to yet.
strings.fetch.error.disk.changed: The part downloaded so far was kept, so it can carry on later.
strings.fetch.error.disk.next: Free up space, then try again.
strings.fetch.error.disk.what: The drive filled up while downloading.
strings.fetch.error.http.changed: Anything already downloaded was kept. Nothing else was changed.
strings.fetch.error.http.next: Check the internet connection and try again.
strings.fetch.error.http.what: The download could not be completed. The internet may be down, or the file may have moved.
strings.fetch.error.not_pinned.next: Update the tool, or ask whoever looks after it.
strings.fetch.error.not_pinned.what: This download is not ready yet: its address has not been checked.
strings.fetch.error.room.next: Free up space on this drive or choose another drive, then try again.
strings.fetch.error.room.what: There is not enough free space for this download.
strings.fetch.error.size.changed: The part that arrived was kept so it can carry on. Nothing else was changed.
strings.fetch.error.size.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, the file may have changed at its source.
strings.fetch.error.size.what: The file that arrived was not the size that was agreed.
strings.fetch.error.unsafe_name.next: Update the tool. If it happens again, save a problem report.
strings.fetch.error.unsafe_name.what: The download's file name was not safe to use.
strings.fetch.why.speech_model: A listening model that turns recordings into text, so each piece can be checked.
strings.fetch.why.voice_amy: Amy, a starting voice. Training begins from a voice that already sounds natural.
strings.fetch.why.voice_mike: Mike, a starting voice. Training begins from a voice that already sounds natural.
strings.job.error.bad_spec.next: Save a problem report. This is a mistake in the tool.
strings.job.error.bad_spec.what: The job could not be started because it was set up wrongly.
strings.job.error.gpu_busy.next: Wait for it to finish, or stop it, then try again.
strings.job.error.gpu_busy.what: Another job is using the graphics card.
strings.job.error.launch_failed.changed: Nothing is running, and your files were not changed.
strings.job.error.launch_failed.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, save a problem report.
strings.job.error.launch_failed.what: The job could not be started.
strings.job.error.network_program.next: Save a problem report. This is a mistake in the tool.
strings.job.error.network_program.what: The job wanted to use the internet, which jobs are never allowed to do.
strings.job.error.no_start.next: It may still start by itself. Look at the job list, and try again if it does not.
strings.job.error.no_start.what: The job did not start in time.
strings.job.error.not_found.next: Close the tool and open it again. If it stays, save a problem report.
strings.job.error.not_found.what: That job's record could not be read.
strings.job.status.interrupted: Interrupted: the computer restarted, or the job was ended from outside
strings.preflight.apt.missing: This computer has no Ubuntu program installer, so the extra programs cannot be added automatically.
strings.preflight.display.none: There is no desktop to show a window on. This tool needs Ubuntu with its desktop, not a text-only session.
strings.preflight.display.none_wsl: WSL cannot show windows yet. Windows and WSL need to be up to date for this.
strings.preflight.display.none_wsl.detail: In Windows, open PowerShell and run: wsl --update. Then close every WSL window, and open Ubuntu again. WSL shows windows on Windows 11, and on recent builds of Windows 10.
strings.preflight.display.ok: There is a screen to show the window on.
strings.preflight.gpu.error: The graphics card driver is not working, so training is switched off. Recording, reviewing and making a training set still work.
strings.preflight.gpu.none: No supported graphics card was found, so training is switched off. Recording, reviewing and making a training set still work, and the finished set can be taken to another computer you own.
strings.preflight.gpu.ok: A graphics card for training was found: {name}.
strings.preflight.gpu.small: A graphics card was found ({name}), but it has less memory than this tool has been tested with. Training may not work. Everything else will.
strings.preflight.gpu.unknown: A graphics card was found ({name}), but its memory could not be read. Training may not work. Everything else will.
strings.preflight.home.on_windows_drive: Your home folder is on a Windows drive, which is slow and not private. Please use the Ubuntu home folder instead.
strings.preflight.os.unknown: Could not tell which version of Linux this is. It may still work.
strings.preflight.os.untested: {name} has not been tested with this tool. It may still work, but that is not guaranteed.
strings.preflight.packages.ok: Every extra program that is needed is already installed.
strings.preflight.platform.native: This is Ubuntu running directly on the computer.
strings.preflight.platform.wsl1: This is the older WSL 1, which cannot use the graphics card or open windows. It needs to be upgraded to WSL 2 first.
strings.preflight.platform.wsl2: This is Ubuntu running inside Windows (WSL 2).
strings.preflight.python.ok: The programming tools this needs are installed.
strings.preflight.python.old: The programming tools on this computer are too old (version {version}; {needed} or newer is needed). Updating Ubuntu will fix this.
strings.preflight.ram.low: This computer has less memory than this tool has been tested with ({memory_mib} MB). Training may be slow, or may not finish.
strings.preflight.ram.unknown: Could not read how much memory this computer has.
strings.preflight.root.blocked: This was started with administrator rights. Please close it and start it again as your normal user, so that your files belong to you.
strings.preflight.root.ok: This is running as your normal user.
strings.preflight.sudo.missing: Installing programs needs administrator rights, and this computer cannot ask for them. Ask whoever looks after this computer to install them.
strings.project.consent.missing.withdraw: How can they change their mind?
strings.project.error.bad_name.next: Type the person's name, or a nickname.
strings.project.error.bad_value.next: Check the settings and try again.
strings.project.error.bad_value.what: One of the project's settings is not allowed.
strings.project.error.consent.next: Fill in who agreed, what to, when, how they can change their mind, and how it was given.
strings.project.error.consent.what: Before recording someone else's voice, a note about who agreed is needed.
strings.project.error.damaged.changed: It was left exactly as it was. Nothing was changed.
strings.project.error.damaged.next: A copy from before its last change is saved beside it. Ask for help putting it back, or save a problem report.
strings.project.error.damaged.what: This person's project file is damaged and cannot be read.
strings.project.error.exists.what: A project folder with that name already exists.
strings.project.error.newer.changed: It was not opened for changes, so nothing was changed.
strings.project.error.newer.next: Update the tool to open it.
strings.project.error.newer.what: This project was made by a newer version of the tool.
strings.project.error.unreadable.next: Check that the drive is connected and that the folder has not been moved.
strings.project.error.unreadable.what: This project's file could not be opened.
strings.project.how_given.through_guardian: Their guardian or supporter agreed for them
strings.project.how_given.using_aac: They said so using their communication device
strings.report.intro: This file was made by ACK Voice Studio so that someone can help work out what went wrong. Read it before you share it. Nothing in it was sent anywhere.
strings.report.log_left_out: The job's log was left out. It can be added if you choose to.
strings.report.log_note: These lines may contain words from recordings or names of folders. Names and folders were hidden, but check them before you share this.
strings.report.not_included: Not included: recordings, anything you or the person said or wrote, names, addresses and passwords. Names and folders were replaced with markers such as <person-1> and <home>.
strings.report.section.log: The end of the job's log
strings.report.title: ACK Voice Studio problem report
strings.scratch.refuse.bad_project_id: This project's name cannot be used as a folder name.
strings.scratch.refuse.cannot_create: A folder cannot be created there.
strings.scratch.refuse.fs_fat: That drive uses an old format that cannot hold these files safely.
strings.scratch.refuse.fs_memory: That is temporary memory, which would be lost when the computer restarts.
strings.scratch.refuse.fs_network: That is a network drive. The voice must not travel over a network.
strings.scratch.refuse.inside_other_project: That folder belongs to another person's project.
strings.scratch.refuse.inside_project: That folder is inside this project's own folders. Choose somewhere else.
strings.scratch.refuse.marker_damaged: That place holds training files that could not be identified, so it was not used.
strings.scratch.refuse.marker_other_project: That place already holds another person's training files.
strings.scratch.refuse.not_a_folder: That is a file, not a folder.
strings.scratch.refuse.not_absolute: Please choose a folder from the list rather than typing a short name.
strings.scratch.refuse.not_empty_unmarked: A folder with that name is already there with other files in it, so it was not used.
strings.scratch.refuse.not_mounted: That drive does not seem to be plugged in. Plug it in and try again.
strings.scratch.refuse.not_writable: You do not have permission to save there.
strings.scratch.refuse.root_folder: The whole drive cannot be used. Choose a folder.
strings.scratch.refuse.synced_folder: That folder is copied to the internet, for example by OneDrive. These files are your voice, so it cannot be used.
strings.scratch.refuse.system_folder: That folder belongs to Ubuntu itself. Choose a different one.
strings.scratch.speed.slow_read: This drive is slow to read from.
strings.scratch.speed.slow_small_files: This drive is slow with many small files, which training uses a great deal.
strings.scratch.speed.slow_write: This drive is slow to save to.
strings.scratch.warn.fs_permissive: This drive uses a Windows-style format. It may be slower.
strings.scratch.warn.fs_unknown: Could not tell what kind of drive this is.
strings.scratch.warn.perms_loose: Other people who use this computer may be able to read files saved here.
strings.scratch.warn.removable: This drive can be unplugged. If it is unplugged during training, training stops until it is back.
strings.scratch.warn.same_device_as_project: This is the same drive as the project, so it will not save any room.
strings.scratch.warn.windows_drive: This is a Windows drive seen from WSL. It is much slower than Ubuntu's own disk.
strings.setup.admin_note: Installing programs needs administrator rights. Ubuntu will ask for your password here, in this window. This tool never sees it.
strings.setup.bad_option: Unknown option: {option}. The options are --check, --dry-run and --yes.
strings.setup.cannot_ask: This cannot ask you a question here, so it did nothing. To go ahead, run it again and add --yes.
strings.setup.cannot_continue: Nothing was changed. Fix the problems above, then run this again.
strings.setup.check_not_ready: Not ready yet: see the lines above.
strings.setup.declined: Nothing was installed and nothing was changed. Run this again when you are ready.
strings.setup.dry_run_header: Dry run: nothing will be changed. This is what would happen:
strings.setup.install_failed: The installation did not finish. Your files were not changed. Look at the messages above, then try again.
strings.setup.installing: Installing. This can take a few minutes.
strings.setup.looking: Looking at this computer. Nothing is changed at this step.
strings.setup.needs_install: These extra programs need to be installed:
strings.setup.question: Install these now? Type y for yes, or press Enter for no:
strings.setup.title: ACK Voice Studio: getting this computer ready
strings.setup.window_not_built: The setup window is not built yet, so there is nothing more to start. This computer is ready for it.
